name: Lower Wards
summary: Collapsed residential districts where Dranik survivors hide from Muramite patrols amid Discord ruptures and temporal echoes.
description: The Lower Wards were once densely populated residential districts of Dranik. Now they lie in ruin, with shattered homes, collapsed streets, and Discord ruptures tearing through the remains. Muramite patrols sweep the area, hunting survivors who hide in makeshift shelters. Temporal echoes replay moments of the siege, creating unpredictable hazards.
